title: Temporary file created with default permissions (c)
description: The code opens a temporary file with tmpfile. The standard leaves permissions and naming policy to the implementation, and on some platforms the file is created world-readable. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer checks how sensitive the content is.
remediation: Create the temporary file with exclusive creation and owner-only mode, for example mkstemp with fchmod 0600.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches temp-file creation without checking the resulting mode.
